description: Cyrisma is a unified platform to continuously identify and mitigate cyber risk. The software combines vulnerability management, data and asset discovery, compliance tracking, secure configuration, and dark web monitoring into one continuous experience - enablingorganizations to identify, prioritize, and remediate cyber risk efficiently.
